Finalized - Ready. In line 24 I left the iota in ιδ dotted. Also added s-etous and slanting strokes after the β, as suggested by Hagedorn (βS//).

Vote - AcceptText - Addressing some of Sosin's concerns: Hagedorn's reading of the etous symbol is surely correct; the vertical stroke is out in the left-hand margin and the horizontal extends clear over to the first numeral of the year. I don't have difficulty seeing the kappa in ἐκμ̣ε̣μ̣ίσθωκα--the left vertical is ligatured to the crossbar of epsilon, but I agree that the iota in ιδ is difficult to make out. Should it be dotted?

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Lin20: προλιπεῖν seems good; the omicron is high (as in ἐντὸς), the ρο (unless I misconstrue) not very much unlike same in τρόπον (21). Lin24 διαφέρουσι quite clear in digital image. Lin29 ἐκμ̣ε̣μ̣ίσθωκα is more plausible (by attested forms) and seems fine/likely to me, but the kappa isn't obvious. Lin29 καὶ βS// seems very clearly correct to me; also the δ in ιδ. But I don't readily see the ι in ιδ (or, is it along that vertical crease?); I am also not positive I see (ἔτους); or, perhaps its vertical is the line that I see above the final υ in Σεουή[ρ]ου? Next voter, perhaps we can look together (or you can with another pair of eyes). http://ipap.csad.ox.ac.uk/4DLink4/4DACTION/IPAPwebquery?vPub=P.Sakaon&vVol=&vNum=71
